title: Torsor triviality implies constant H1 vanishing
statement: Let R be a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] with separably closed fraction field [def-pc-separably-closed], Z a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion] of Spec R [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and M a finite abelian group. Let F be its constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale site of Z. If every F-torsor [def-weil-pbc-finite-torsors] is equivariantly isomorphic to the trivial torsor, then the first derived etale cohomology object [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] of F is zero.

proof.text: Torsor classification makes Ext-defined H1 a subsingleton. An injective resolution compares Ext with derived global sections; an additive group object with subsingleton underlying type is zero.
